sources.note: Main vendor homepage. Describes Advantage Intelligence as all-in-one platform for 13+ specialties. Lists core modules: EHR, practice management, RCM, patient engagement (DREAM suite), optical POS, ASC, eCommerce, analytics.

ONC certification page. Lists Version 12 certification, references Updox and Surescripts integration, DICOM conformance, IHE participation, HIPAA readiness, FHIR API documentation, and real-world testing plans 2022-2026.

Ophthalmology specialty page. Details AI-powered EHR with OneTab layout, subspecialty charting (glaucoma flowsheet, cataract/LASIK), Ambient Virtual Scribe, SMART Orders, integrated practice management, optical POS, ASC module, patient engagement, analytics.

Optometry specialty page. Describes AI-powered optometry EHR with extensive eye care medical database, one-tab layout, practice management, optical POS, patient engagement, RCM, eCommerce, analytics, and integrated marketing.

Patient engagement feature page. Details Promptly/Advantage Patient Experience suite: online scheduling, insurance verification, mobile check-in, digital forms with e-signatures in 100+ languages, text-to-pay, cost estimation, referral portal, reputation management, driver's license/insurance card scanning.

Promptly product page — Compulink's patient engagement platform. Same features as patient engagement page: scheduling, insurance/demographics, cost estimation, mobile check-in, digital forms, payment processing, automated communications, reputation management, insurance eligibility, referral tracking.
ASC module page. Features include patient registration, case scheduling, preference cards, inventory management, lab/pathology integration, and administrative/statistical/outcomes reporting.

June 2018 press release on name change from Compulink to Compulink Healthcare Solutions. Founded 1985, PM software first, EHR added 1994. At time: 160 employees, 20,000+ providers, 4,700+ locations, 19 specialties. CEO Link Wilson. Headquartered Newbury Park, CA.

Third-party review aggregator. 4/5 stars (37 reviews). Lists features: customizable charts, e-prescribing, lab interfacing, PQRS coding, patient portal, scheduling, Android/iOS apps. Cloud-based. Starting $133/month. Mixed reviews on learning curve and post-update stability.

Software Advice profile. Confirms specialty EHR for urology, PT, dermatology, addiction, audiology, GI, mental health, podiatry, orthopedics, ENT, optometry, ophthalmology. Cloud-based or server deployment.
Capterra listing (reviews page returned 403). Search results indicated: 96% found it easy to use, 97% praised customer support. Complaints about excessive clicks and learning curve.
ASCRS 2024 press release. Mentions DICOM interface replacing legacy systems, automatic image push to PACS, and integration with leading diagnostic devices alongside the EHR.
HIMSS 2018 press release reference. Compulink debuted multi-specialty group solution, indicating expansion beyond single-specialty practices.
